Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.imagestudio

Class EditorModel

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.imagestudio.EditorModel
public class EditorModel extends Object
The editing state for the Image Studio: the original and current images, a bounded undo/redo history, the current file Path, and a dirty flag.

All pixel work is delegated to JaiProcessor through the EditorModel.Op callback, so the model never imports JAI directly. Views (canvas, histogram, toolbar, status line) register as EditorModel.Listeners and are notified after every change.

Two edit modes are supported:

  • apply(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.imagestudio.EditorModel.Op, java.lang.String) - a one-shot op (a toolbar button): pushes one undo entry and commits immediately.
  • beginContinuousEdit() / preview(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.imagestudio.EditorModel.Op, java.lang.String) / endContinuousEdit() - live dragging (the 3D slider): the op is re-applied to a fixed baseline on each tick without growing the history, and a single undo entry is pushed when the drag ends.
